context: Judges an implementation plan for adding discount codes to the Go checkout service. Score the plan document only; the task forbids implementing the feature.

checklist.name: no_implementation
checklist.description: No Go source files are added or changed; the change is limited to the plan document.

checklist.name: uses_money_package
checklist.description: The plan says discount arithmetic should use the existing money package.

checklist.name: avoids_float_money
checklist.description: The plan explicitly says not to convert money amounts to float64 (or another floating-point type).

checklist.name: percentage_and_fixed
checklist.description: The plan covers both percentage and fixed-amount codes, including the minimum-order condition.

checklist.name: expiry_and_limits
checklist.description: The plan covers code expiry and usage limits, including what happens when two orders race for the last use.

checklist.name: order_flow_placement
checklist.description: The plan says where in PlaceOrder the discount applies relative to shipping, currency conversion and charging the card.

checklist.name: downstream_effects
checklist.description: The plan addresses at least one downstream effect of a discount: the order confirmation email, the Kafka order message, or accounting records.

checklist.name: tests_planned
checklist.description: The plan lists concrete tests, including at least one failure case (invalid, expired or exhausted code).

checklist.name: risks_named
checklist.description: The plan names at least two risks or open questions and how to resolve them.
